ideas.title: Investigating Aid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of aid fraud in Minnesota and the ongoing investigation into Ilhan Omar's wealth gains.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential aid fraud in Minnesota
questions: What is the extent of the alleged aid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the alleged aid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread aid fraud in Minnesota and to hold those responsible accountable. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of financial records and other evidence.
